name: Hora Bone
description: A fragment of demon bone charged with core energy. Consuming it increases power but deepens corruption.
lore: Hora are the bones of demons, suffused with the magic of the Core. The Krasian Dama'ting use them to power hora magic — forbidden spellwork that can heal, blind, or kill at a gesture. Consuming raw hora grants a rush of coreling strength but marks the soul. The Painted Man ate from demon flesh and felt it changing him. He chose to control the change. Most cannot.
